violations.title: S3 Bucket allows public read access
violations.description: The S3 bucket is configured to allow public read access, which may expose sensitive data.
violations.impact: Publicly accessible buckets can lead to data leakage and compliance violations.
violations.issue: S3 bucket has ACL set to public-read

advice: Do not use public-read or public-read-write ACLs.
Restrict access using IAM policies or bucket policies.
